## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (78%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Low reliability on this resampled frozen section triggers drafted recut/deeper-level orders and defers margin calls to permanent sections [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 78%, Normal 22%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% [F1] (ECE 5%, n=132) | Favors Benign over Normal |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at alpha=0.10 (90% test coverage, CI 76%–98%, n=132) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee only |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 46%, OOD 88th percentile, flagged [F6] (AUROC 0.70, n=1716) | Suspect resampled input; reduced trust |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class (false) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign, 3/5 Normal (40% agree; 85%–87% similarity) [F5] | Split between Normal and Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (0.07, contribution -0.48) pushes away from invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.19, contribution -0.35; caption inconsistent) lowers risk [F3] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.21, contribution +0.30) slightly raises invasive score [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Lower spatial fraction (contribution +0.15) slightly raises invasive score · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); AI-checked mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), and necrosis (3/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Resampled frozen-section artifact (severity 3) masks focal pathology in high-risk regions 0 (0.75) and 3 (0.62) or margins (99%).
- Tissue is actually Normal (22% probability; 3/5 neighbors and 87%-similar BACH_0192 are Normal; CONCH–MUSK disagree; cells disabled).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 3**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (risk 0.75, 0.62) for nuclear pleomorphism versus frozen-section resampling artifact.
2. **Regions 1, 3, 6, 8, 9, 10**: Verify benign tubules and stroma versus Normal lobular architecture (contrast case BACH_0192).
3. **Regions 0, 11**: Review inferior/lateral (99%) and superior (59%) margins; consider drafted recut and deeper levels.
